**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Subtract enrolled testers from the remaining count**

The linked eligibility evidence records 2 testers currently opted in against a required total of 12, so only 10 additional testers are needed to reach the threshold, not 12. Reporting 12 as still missing can misdirect recruitment and invitation planning; clarify that the requirement is 12 total for 14 days or change the remaining count to 10.

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.

Corrected in b22d3e99b: the checkpoint now explicitly requires twelve total for fourteen days and says ten additional opt-ins are missing. Existing evidence remains two enrolled; no invitations or eligibility state were altered.

**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Synchronize UX-260917-004's status fields**

This new merge status says mobile #105–114 are merged and parent #435/#449 already contain the correction, but the same record's `releaseStatus` still says #106 is pending and Android 15/QA 46b1 are in progress, while `verificationStatus` still says parent #435 is pending. Consumers of `findings.json` therefore receive mutually incompatible release state; update the entire finding to the Android 17/iOS 25/parent #454 checkpoint rather than only its merge and implementation fields.

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.

Addressed in 33efe613f: all UX004 verification/release/merge fields now use published mobile2a0e5a9, signed iOS25/Android17, actual Samsung QA and pending parent454. Superseded status text is preserved explicitly as historical evidence. Related obsolete finding/static-page states were reconciled without closing unexecuted acceptance. Main7635a5f is integrated; regeneration proves current mobile/web contract parity with no mobile code change. User has no physical iPhone; that gate remains blocked.

**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Remove the completed Android submission step**

For an operator following the current top checkpoint, this next action is already complete: lines 55–57 record that Android 17 was validated, committed to Alpha, submitted, and confirmed `in review`. Keeping “verificar el envío” as the next step can trigger redundant release work; the remaining action should instead be to monitor review and eventual tester availability.

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.

Addressed in 33efe613f. The next action now concerns parent review/merge and eventual store review/tester availability, expressly prohibiting repetition of completed uploads. Live read-only Apple and Play observations retain iOS25 WAITING_FOR_REVIEW/MANUAL and Android17 in review. Backend observation is also refreshed to the other operator’s mail-only ab9 release; this parent does not initiate a competing backend rollout.
